tombstone: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Boating in Spring Water, 1684. Zha Shibiao (Chinese, 1615–1698). Album leaf, ink and light color on paper; overall: 29.9 x 39.4 cm (11 3/4 x 15 1/2 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Severance A. Millikin, 1955.37.3
title: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Boating in Spring Water
technique: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

inscriptions.inscription:
Artist's inscription, signature, and seal:

"Boating in spring water is like sailing in the sky"  [from a poem by Lu Yu, 1125-1210].  While painting this, I thought of the quotation and thus recorded it.  The third month of the jiazi year [1684]. Shibiao [seal] Erzhan. [seal, upper right] Shibiao.
